Chapter 6338: I Might Be Nothing

Chapter 6338: I Might Be Nothing

You are nothing - silence took over after this statement.

Some have heard this before during their novice days. However, an emperor on the limit path?

Li Qiye didn’t bother looking directly at the emperor while speaking with the most casual tone, only giving him one glance.

Despite all signs pointing at him being a mortal, his demeanor just now matched that of a supreme ancestor looking down on a helpless ant.

After a long while, the crowd regained their wits. Their position leaned toward the opposite side ever so slightly after hearing Li Qiye. Perhaps he was indeed an ancient ancestor despite the lack of records.

Ten-realm visibly became frustrated. His cultivation was enough to roam the world but most importantly, his status as the successor of the Chen.

He felt the disdainful glance of Li Qiye as if he was not worthy of time - something truly unprecedented. He had only done it to others, not vice versa.

No one could stay calm under these circumstances, especially not a prideful emperor who had enjoyed enough success.

“I might be nothing, the same as the evidence supporting your identity. How will you prove it?” Ten-realm took a deep breath to not lose his cool and do something unbecoming of his status.

“Get out of my sight before I become annoyed.” Li Qiye waved his hand as if chasing a fly.

Everyone couldn’t believe the contempt being shown to an apex emperor.

Goldclad and Lostmetal’s opinion swung slightly to the other side. No ordinary mortal could act this haughtily.

“Hahaha.” Ten-realm turned red from anger and burst out laughing.

“As a junior, I will overestimate myself and ask you for pointers.” He said before summoning a pagoda.

It had ten floors; its weight caused the world to sink ever so slightly. Everyone became frozen upon seeing it floating above his palm.

“Try this!” He roared and attacked.

“Ten-realm Pagoda!” Huntblade and the others were startled.

Ten-realm was not messing around and started with his fate weapon that had killed many mighty foes.

“Bam!” Many members of the sect dropped to the ground, paralyzed.

He swung the pagoda straight for Li Qiye with the force of ten realms. Mountains shattered and laws were obliterated.

“Stop!” Crimson Virtue used his majestic anima power to erect a wall of countless sages.

As an emperor at the origination stage, this wall of energy beings could surround numerous sects and kingdoms.

“Bam!” The impact caused severe damage to Desolate Frontier despite an innate protection left behind by Desolate Ancestor.

Pavilions and palaces were uprooted, the same for some peaks and rivers.

“Rumble!” The pagoda pushed the wall back.

Crimson Virtue mustered all of his strength. His anima tree appeared and empowered him, showing signs of becoming primal. However, a limit-path emperor was just too strong.

His wall was being pushed back despite his best efforts.

“Enough of this outrageous act, back off already, Ten-realm!” Solar Monarch interfered.

He hoped Ten-realm would know when to quit instead of escalating the conflict.
